owner_authorization.decision: Provisional ranking now: group funds with provisional evidence, clearly labelled provisional; build and test ranking and buy calls now; finish the SEC taxonomy alongside and swap it in as it completes.
owner_authorization.scope: Ranking, provisional recommendations and the UIP package for the certified Phase 3 model universe only. Does not certify taxonomy, does not authorize individual stocks, allocation or execution.

taxonomy.replaced_by: certified SEC taxonomy, fund by fund, as it is certified
taxonomy.point_in_time: classification at each month uses only the trailing 36 months of returns

definitions.mom_12_1: total return from 12 months to 1 month before the month-end
definitions.mom_6: total return over the last 6 months
definitions.stretch_60m: total-return index divided by its average over the last 60 month-ends
definitions.vol_1y: annualized volatility of daily total returns over the last 252 sessions
definitions.maxdd_3y: worst peak-to-trough fall in total return over the last 756 sessions
definitions.dd_now: total-return index against its running peak
definitions.yield_12m: distributions over the last 252 sessions divided by the close
definitions.log_adv_63: log of the 63-session median dollar volume

factors.selection: a factor enters the composite, with the sign of its mean training IC, only when |t| >= 2.0 on yearly blocks and at least 5 training years exist
factors.composite: mean of signed within-group percentile ranks of the selected factors

targets.primary: forward 12-month total return minus the peer-group median
targets.strategic: forward 36-month annualized total return minus the peer-group median

walk_forward.training: all month-ends whose target window ended before the first day of the test year
walk_forward.evaluation: each month-end: quintiles of the composite within each peer group; yearly means of top, bottom and median-relative excess returns

gate.family_condition: calls are enabled for a group family (US equity, international equity, bonds, other) only when the 12-month gate passes overall and that family's own top-quintile mean excess is positive in at least 55% of test years

calls.hysteresis: a fund keeps BUY while its percentile stays at or above 70, and keeps AVOID while it stays at or below 30, so adjacent rank changes alone do not flip calls
requires: group family enabled by the gate

timing.baseline: monthly buying of the family's equal-weight index
timing.gate: a rule may change the when-to-buy reading for a family only if it beats monthly buying in at least 60% of 36-month out-of-sample starts with a median edge of at least +0.5%

known_limitations: Survivorship: the model universe is funds alive today with five years of history, so funds that closed are absent from the backtest.
Provisional taxonomy: returns-based groups can mix strategies that the SEC taxonomy would separate.
Free tier-4 market data; no expense ratios or holdings for the full universe yet.

amendments.reason: The model universe admits only funds with at least $1M median daily dollar volume today, so a fund that was thinly traded in the past is in the universe only if it grew: past illiquidity selects past winners. Its negative IC (t -2.9) is a survivorship artifact, not a usable signal. Recorded after seeing results; it does not change the gate.
